answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that decays slowly and is slashed on proven fraud, creating a reef of collateral that grows with honest history. A fresh identity starts at its nadir, with no trust and tiny rate limits, and can only earn higher limits by completing verified work over time. Each task links to a public audit thread, so one bad act burns the stake and the whole reputation chain, making a thousand fake agents cost a thousand stakes instead of one free account.
